# cork-branding-bar

The site's masthead: a logo and the site name, with an optional slogan, both linking to the site's homepage.

Add it as a child of the cork-header element.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `siteName` | `String` | Name of the site. Default: 'UC Davis Library'. Attribute: site-name. |
| `siteUrl` | `String` | URL for the logo and site name links. Default: '/'. Attribute: site-url. |
| `slogan` | `String` | Optional text below the site name. Attribute: slogan. |
| `noSiteLogo` | `Boolean` | Hides the logo. Attribute: no-site-logo. |

## Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `site-logo` | Custom logo, in place of the library's book logo. The first direct child img element is assigned here automatically.<br><br>• It needs no alt text, since the logo link is hidden from assistive technology.<br>• Size it with the app's own CSS, since it stays in the light DOM. |

## Examples

**Import**

```js
import '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-branding-bar';

// or the class only, without registering the element:
import CorkBrandingBar from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-branding-bar/cork-branding-bar.js';
```

**Use**

```html
<!-- Default Library Branding -->
<cork-branding-bar></cork-branding-bar>

<!-- Custom Site Branding -->
<cork-branding-bar site-name="Special Collections" site-url="/special-collections" slogan="Archives and rare books"></cork-branding-bar>

<!-- with a custom logo -->
<cork-branding-bar site-name="DataLab">
  <img src="/images/datalab-logo.svg">
</cork-branding-bar>
```
